about_short_description.short_description: CHECK24 is a comparison portal that helps customers evaluate various services.

product.name: Kfz-Versicherungsvergleich (Car Insurance Comparison)
product.description: A service to compare over 330 car insurance tariffs to find suitable coverage and pricing.

product.name: Baufinanzierungsvergleich (Mortgage Financing Comparison)
product.description: A platform to compare mortgage financing offers from over 650 providers for property purchase or construction.

product.name: Stromvergleich (Electricity Comparison)
product.description: An online tool to compare electricity tariffs from over 1,000 providers and facilitate switching.

product.name: Gasvergleich (Gas Comparison)
product.description: A comparison service for gas tariffs from more than 850 providers, enabling users to find and switch to suitable gas suppliers.

product.name: Internet-Vergleich (Internet Tariff Comparison)
product.description: A platform to compare internet tariffs from over 300 providers and more than 3,500 plans, including DSL, cable, and fiber.

product.name: Mietwagenvergleich (Car Rental Comparison)
product.description: A service to compare car rental offers from nearly 900 providers at over 80,000 locations worldwide.
